facts.fact: The Aviso creates SPIM, a 24-hour instant payment system making funds available to the beneficiary within 25 seconds, in force 2 March 2026, with participation by credit institutions and payment service companies and mandatory for e-money institutions; daily limits MT 200,000 for persons and MT 500,000 for legal entities.
facts.system: Sistema de Pagamentos Instantâneos de Moçambique (SPIM)

facts.fact: Participation in SPIM is mandatory for e-money institutions and for credit institutions above set thresholds, so wallets and banks exchange instant payments through it; interbank transactions ordered by individuals are free of fees.
facts.system: Sistema de Pagamentos Instantâneos de Moçambique (SPIM)

systems.tiers: MT 200,000 natural persons; MT 500,000 legal persons
